officialSources.evidence: Official local procedure table names Văn phòng ĐKĐĐ Chi nhánh Quy Nhơn as the implementing agency for first land-use registration and related land procedures. This is direct local registry-branch evidence, not merely national agency prose.

officialSources.operator: Sở Tài nguyên và Môi trường tỉnh Bình Định
officialSources.evidence: Official provincial department page describes land registration, certificates, and management/update/correction of cadastral records within its delegated remit. It does not expose an anonymous parcel feature service.

Official system landing page identifies a restricted government land-information system deployed with provincial departments and integrated with land registration. The page is an access-controlled lead, not an open Quy Nhơn parcel API.
